chart:EC2.imageQuote: EC2 allows you to rent and manage virtual servers in the cloud.

chart:Lambda.imageQuote: Lambda is a serverless compute service that lets you run code without managing servers.

chart:Fargate.imageQuote: Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers.

chart:Lightsail.imageQuote: Lightsail allows you to quickly launch all the resources you need for small projects.

chart:Outposts.imageQuote: Outposts allows you to run cloud services in your internal data center.

chart:Batch.imageQuote: Batch allows you to process large workloads in smaller chunks (or batches).

chart:S3.imageQuote: S3 is an object storage service for the cloud that is highly available.

chart:EBS.imageQuote: EBS is a storage device (called a volume) that can be attached to (or removed from) your instance.

chart:EFS.imageQuote: EFS is a serverless network file system for sharing files.

chart:Storage Gateway.imageQuote: Storage Gateway is a hybrid storage service.

chart:Backup.imageQuote: Backup helps you manage data backups across multiple data services in the cloud.

chart:CloudFront.imageQuote: CloudFront is a CDN that delivers data and applications globally with low latency.

chart:Global Accelerator.imageQuote: Global Accelerator sends your users through the AWS global network when accessing your content, speeding up delivery.

chart:S3 Transfer Acceleration.imageQuote: S3 Transfer Acceleration improves content uploads and downloads to and from S3 buckets.

chart:Route 53.imageQuote: Route 53 is a DNS service that routes users to applications.

chart:VPC.imageQuote: VPC is a foundational service that allows you to create a secure private network in the AWS Cloud where you launch your resources.

chart:Direct Connect.imageQuote: Direct Connect is a dedicated physical network connection from your on-premises data center to AWS.

chart:Site-to-Site VPN.imageQuote: Site-to-Site VPN creates a secure connection between your internal networks and your AWS VPCs.

chart:API Gateway.imageQuote: API Gateway allows you to build and manage APIs.

chart:RDS.imageQuote: RDS is a service that makes it easy to launch and manage relational databases.

chart:Aurora.imageQuote: Aurora is a relational database compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL that was created by AWS.

chart:DynamoDB.imageQuote: DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database.

chart:DocumentDB.imageQuote: DocumentDB is a fully managed document database that supports MongoDB.

chart:ElastiCache.imageQuote: ElastiCache is a fully managed in-memory datastore compatible with Redis or Memcached.

chart:Neptune.imageQuote: Neptune is a fully managed graph database that supports highly connected datasets.

chart:DMS.imageQuote: DMS helps you migrate databases to or within AWS.

chart:SMS.imageQuote: SMS allows you to migrate on-premises servers to AWS.

chart:Snow Family.imageQuote: The Snow Family allows you to transfer large amounts of on-premises data to AWS using a physical device.

chart:DataSync.imageQuote: DataSync allows for online data transfer from on-premises to AWS storage services like S3 or EFS.

chart:Redshift.imageQuote: Redshift is a scalable data warehouse solution.

chart:Athena.imageQuote: Athena is a query service for Amazon S3.

chart:Glue.imageQuote: Glue prepares your data for analytics.

chart:Kinesis.imageQuote: Kinesis allows you to analyze data and video streams in real time.

chart:EMR.imageQuote: EMR helps you process large amounts of data.

chart:Data Pipeline.imageQuote: Data Pipeline helps you move data between compute and storage services running either on AWS or on-premises.

chart:Rekognition.imageQuote: Rekognition allows you to automate your image and video analysis.

chart:Comprehend.imageQuote: Comprehend is a natural-language processing (NLP) service that finds relationships in text.

chart:SageMaker.imageQuote: SageMaker helps you build, train, and deploy machine learning models quickly.

chart:Lex.imageQuote: Lex helps you build conversational interfaces like chatbots.

chart:Cloud9.imageQuote: Cloud9 allows you to write code within an integrated development environment (IDE) right from your web browser.

chart:CodeCommit.imageQuote: CodeCommit is a source control system for private Git repositories.

chart:CodeBuild.imageQuote: CodeBuild allows you to build and test your application source code.

chart:CodeDeploy.imageQuote: CodeDeploy manages the deployment of code to compute services in the cloud or on-premises.

chart:CodePipeline.imageQuote: CodePipeline automates the software release process.

chart:X-Ray.imageQuote: X-Ray helps you debug production applications.

chart:CloudFormation.imageQuote: CloudFormation allows you to provision AWS resources using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

chart:Elastic Beanstalk.imageQuote: Elastic Beanstalk allows you to deploy your web applications and web services to AWS.

chart:OpsWorks.imageQuote: OpsWorks allows you to use Chef or Puppet to automate the configuration of your servers and deploy code.

chart:SQS.imageQuote: SQS is a message queuing service that allows you to build loosely coupled systems.

chart:SNS.imageQuote: SNS allows you to send emails and text messages from your applications.

chart:SES.imageQuote: SES is an email service that allows you to send richly formatted HTML emails from your applications.

chart:CloudWatch.imageQuote: CloudWatch is a collection of services that help you monitor and observe your cloud resources.

chart:CloudTrail.imageQuote: CloudTrail tracks user activity and API calls within your account.

chart:IAM.imageQuote: IAM allows you to control access to your AWS services and resources.

chart:WAF.imageQuote: WAF helps protect your web applications against common web attacks.

chart:Shield.imageQuote: Shield is a managed Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection service.

chart:Macie.imageQuote: Macie helps you discover and protect sensitive data.

chart:Config.imageQuote: Config allows you to assess, audit, and evaluate the configurations of your resources.

chart:GuardDuty.imageQuote: GuardDuty is an intelligent threat detection system that uncovers unauthorized behavior.

chart:Inspector.imageQuote: Inspector works with EC2 instances to uncover and report vulnerabilities.

chart:Artifact.imageQuote: Artifact offers on-demand access to AWS security and compliance reports.

chart:Cognito.imageQuote: Cognito helps you control access to mobile and web applications.

chart:KMS.imageQuote: KMS allows you to generate and store encryption keys.

chart:CloudHSM.imageQuote: CloudHSM is a hardware security module (HSM) used to generate encryption keys.

chart:Secrets Manager.imageQuote: Secrets Manager allows you to manage and retrieve secrets (passwords or keys).
